question: With the cameras' own slow pan removed, does a state on the measured seed's generator cycle near the model's draw count reproduce the camera static's flicker in held-out winding windows better than chance?

hypothesis.source: docs/evidence/full06-static-readout-confirm-20261001.json (NOT_SUPPORTED, 1 of 4 hits, raw period means). Retained native frames of the camera view (artifacts/campaign-2026-09-27T19-30-35.284Z lifecycle frames 00011 and 00015) show the camera picture panning sideways on its own, so the period means carry a slow drift under the static's 0.1 s steps. Exploratory, on already-seen windows only: removing a centred 5-period running mean from both series lifts the same seed-cycle offsets, wind-1 d 6 from r 0.497 to 0.673 and wind-2 d 8 from 0.734 to 0.786, against 400 random states whose detrended r reach 0.68 and 0.56 at most.
hypothesis.statement: E-seed-ahead, read without the pan: the measured seed is right and the phone spends a few more draws than the model.

tool.note: The scan started (01:13:48 -03) on the file as committed in 5b4d12b9; adcf9c2f (01:17) added the native static recording path to frames() and a null-luma skip to blocks() while it ran, so windows whose workers spawned later loaded the edited file. On full-06 frames() takes the grid path in both versions (no staticReadout in the night) and its 24,984 grid_mean_luma values hold no null, so the skip never fires: both versions compute the same series.

reading.explanations: E-seed-ahead read without the pan predicted SUPPORTED and is not confirmed: 0 of 4 held-out windows hit. The lift detrending gave wind-1 and wind-2 was found on windows already seen and does not carry to untouched ones.
reading.offsets: The best cycle offsets are wind-7 d -16 (r 0.528, p 0.467), wind-8 d -15 (r 0.462, p 0.982), wind-9 d -58 (r 0.534, p 0.407), wind-10 d -60 (r 0.712, p 0.018). All four are negative, none near the +6 and +8 found on the seen windows, and only wind-10's sits under 0.05.
reading.instrument: Detrending does not rescue the grid: every window's best r over all 65,536 states is 0.811, 0.757, 0.725, 0.752, again near the chance maximum of a 31-32 period series. Two predeclared tests on the grid (raw 1 of 4, detrended 0 of 4) now agree that the 20x9 point grid cannot read this night's random stream. The native recording (night-run.sh --frame-trace --static-readout) is the instrument this leaves, on a new attended measurement night.

open: An attended traced Night 7 with the native static readout (Pedro, 2026-10-01: "Build it, run when I'm here"); confirm the static_view rectangle on a live SNAP of the winding view first.
